messages.text: Firmware validation takes about 4 days once boards are populated.
I'll pair with Lee on firmware validation once I'm back on Nov 12.
I'll run board assembly with Dana once harnesses arrive, about 1 day.
Reminder: EVT build is Nov 14. Board assembly needs both the harnesses and the sensors in hand before then.
Cable harness × 12 for Rev C: current vendor quoted 9 days and has no expedite. Second vendor can do 5 days but we've only ordered from them once.
I'm on Thermal & EMC with Anya. We need about 3 days in the chamber.
Thermal & EMC runs on the same Rev C boards, so it can only start after firmware validation is done. Tentatively booked the thermal chamber for the week of Nov 10.
Firmware validation on Rev C is blocked until the ACS37002 sensors land. Rev B doesn't have the new sense path, so we can't start on Rev B boards.
Rev C power board BOM is final. Still missing the ACS37002 current sensors, need 40. Digi-Key standard is 12 days.
